# AI Automation Kings (AIAK)

> I build websites and search visibility for local businesses, custom AI agents for specific jobs, and One Brain to connect a team's tools and knowledge.

Founded by Nathan Mamo. Based in Houston, Texas. The site has a shared homepage and three separate pages: Websites & Search, Custom AI Development, and One Brain. One Brain is its own complete experience at `/one-brain`.

## One Brain

- **AI automation.** I map how work moves through your business and automate repetitive steps within an agreed process.
- **Custom AI agents.** Each agent has a clear job, shared business context, and only the access its job needs.
- **CRM and sales automation.** I connect inquiries, follow-up, conversation history, and customer records around your existing sales process.
- **Connections.** I connect the tools and information the work needs, so your team can reduce repeated handoffs and copying between systems.
- **AI workshops and training.** I train your team on its real tasks and the system built around them.

These five services come together in one business brain. I scope the first useful workflow, its sources, permissions, approval points, ownership, maintenance, and full costs before building.

## How it works

I connect your tools and business knowledge so AI can prepare repetitive work, such as client follow-up, documents, and team handoffs. Your team sets the instructions, access, and approval rules. I start with one useful workflow, test it with your team, then train your team to use it.

The One Brain page follows a task through source information, draft preparation, and human review. Visitors can choose law firms, accountants, healthcare practices, or consulting, then explore follow-ups, documents, and team handoffs. Each example includes relevant software, source notes, and an editable draft. These are fictional administrative examples, not client case studies. More workflow examples are available in an optional explorer. The page also includes a simplified 3D illustration of how I use AI in my own business: managing client work, coordinating projects with Ken at CompuSolutionX, and research. These examples do not connect real accounts or send messages. Tool logos identify software a business may use; they do not imply a partnership or endorsement.

## Working with CompuSolutionX

Ken (Kenneth) Akiri at CompuSolutionX is my partner in AI consulting and implementation. He is an IT expert with the technical understanding behind the work, and he now uses AI to build robust systems faster. CompuSolutionX's public company history dates its founding to 2002. The partnership section links to Ken's October 2021 SHOUTOUT HTX founder interview and a Diamond Dialysis website support credit. These describe CompuSolutionX experience, not AIA Kings client results. Platform artwork identifies technology referenced on CompuSolutionX's website and does not establish an AIA Kings certification or endorsement.

CompuSolutionX displays a 2022 Forbes Business Council membership badge, a Microsoft Gold Partner badge, and an Intel Technology Provider badge on its own website. The section attributes these references to CompuSolutionX and links to its awards and partnerships pages. These references have not been independently confirmed as current credentials and are not AIA Kings credentials or endorsements.

## Limits

No business result, ranking position, or placement in an AI answer is guaranteed. No outbound lead generation, cold email service, social media management, or paid ads management is offered. Work starts with one scoped job, tested before it expands. Customer-facing messages and other consequential actions follow the approval rules agreed for that workflow.
